shortDescription: Certificate operations for PowerStore Storage System

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: certificate
options.description: Concatenated PEM encoded x509_certificate string from end-entity certificate to root certificate.

options.name: certificate_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the certificate. Mandatory only for modify operation.

options.name: is_current
options.description: Indicates whether this is the current X509 certificate to be used by the service or this X509 Certificate will be used in the future.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: remote_address
options.description: IPv4 or DNS name of the remote cluster.

options.name: remote_password
options.description: The password of the remote cluster.

options.name: remote_port
options.description: The port address of the remote cluster.

options.name: remote_user
options.description: The username of the remote cluster.

options.name: scope
options.description: Defines a subset of certificates belonging to one service.

options.name: service
options.description: Type of the service for which the certificate is used. Mandatory for reset and exchange operation.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the certificate should exist or not.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
